scope: Mixed precision accuracy monitoring, active scalar-master precision provenance, full returned Taylor coefficient checks, and raw-distance precision relevance. Validation times are not benchmarks.

behavior.requested_accuracy: Unchanged; no silent promotion or target cap
behavior.master_gate: Inspect nonzero components of actual active requests plus original mu jets; require effective bits +15 >= requested bits. Full constant scaleless jets exempt.
behavior.weighted_estimates: Each nonzero real/imag operand contributes at its actual tracked precision, capped by prototype. Dynamic Float reserves3 guard bits. Every returned Laurent/Taylor coefficient is checked.
behavior.range_policy: Underflowed or subnormal error estimates use positive magnitude only when unit<=1; otherwise reject. Finite normal unit>1 remains magnitude weighted under unchanged dimensional target.
behavior.relevance: Raw distances scan only original shifts or authoritative supplied scalar products, excluding masses and scale.

limitations: Conditioning monitors are estimates, not certified error bounds. Symbolica tracks relative precision and clamps it at1 after severe cancellation; no separate absolute-error metadata is retained.
Active-request gate is conservative for exact coincidences, analytically unused scale, and tiny weak nonzero seeds.
Scalar backend correctness and full performance acceptance are separate qualifications.
